summary: Enrich handoff data in AssembledContext to include individual results for detailed checklists
context: formatForLLM previously showed one-line handoff summaries. Agents couldn't tell what was done vs remaining without reading the full handoff record separately.
rationale: Loading full HandoffRecord (via handoffStore.get) costs one file read per handoff (max 5) but provides structured results with status icons ([x], [ ], [BLOCKED]) that give agents an actionable checklist of what to continue.

alternatives.reason_rejected: Agents couldn't distinguish completed from blocked work items without reading handoff records separately
Would bloat the index file and change the storage format for all consumers
